author: Trotsky, Leon
title: My Life: An Attempt at an Autobiography
notes: Written in exile on Prinkipo in 1929 and read here in full on the Marxists Internet Archive, which gives chapters but no printed pages; citations name the chapter. Chapter 34, 'The Train', is the only sustained first-person account of the object this pack is built around. It is a memoir written by a man who had lost, defending a record against the men who had taken it from him, and every figure in it - the thirty-six journeys, the hundred and five thousand kilometres - is his own.
